mission_brief.objective: Our VP of Growth thinks we have a churn problem specifically in the Enterprise tier this quarter. Our CFO thinks it's actually a pricing problem across all tiers and Enterprise just looks worse because of mix shift. Figure out what's actually going on with Q2 and tell us what to do. Also, if you get a chance, check whether support ticket volume is driving any of this — I think support's been slower this quarter. We need this by Friday.
mission_brief.stakeholder_type: VP of Growth and CFO (executive leadership)
mission_brief.data_source_description: Data's in the warehouse: users, events, subscriptions, and a billing table that our old system also wrote to before we migrated in April. No support ticket table available. We rolled out a 15% Enterprise price increase on April 1st. Also FYI, our biggest Enterprise reseller partner ended their contract March 28th.

H2 will quantify the secondary cause (price increase impact). H3 provides crucial context on *who* was affected by the price increase. Testing these in order will build the narrative logically for the stakeholders.
